text: Data/ROM integer round trips shall preserve every accepted numeric value exactly. Pointer round trips shall cover null and uniquely mapped live strict-interior positions with canonical object/space rights, excluding expired, one-past, and attenuated-rights values. Adjacent boundaries may reconstruct a different allocation; no hidden integer provenance shall be retained.
